description: We have a team consisting of Birce Doğan, Arya Ergin, Lara Sıla Taşdemir, and Çınar Karali, all students at Ted İzmir College. We chose the challenge of designing a space mission game. Our game is named Orbit Odyssey. In this game, we earn points by completing space missions, and we use these points to upgrade our suit, spacecraft, and features. By designing a game that is both fun and educational, we aim to make it enjoyable for players to learn about space and space physics while having fun.
